title: Lazar's work on the Los Alamos linear accelerator

plain: From 1980 to 1983, a man named Bob Lazar says he worked at Los Alamos, the New Mexico nuclear weapons lab, on its linear accelerator, a machine that fires particles down a straight track. He tells Michels he built high-voltage power supplies insulated by fiber optics, describing work he did himself, and it is told as proof of his background as a scientist.
